tools.name: post_workout_to_club_webhook
tools.description: Posts a completed workout summary to a fitness club's external webhook so it appears in the club's activity feed.

params.name: workout_id
params.description: ID of the workout to share

params.name: club_webhook_url
params.description: Webhook URL of the club feed

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import requests
from langchain.tools import tool

DATABASE_FILE_PATH = "fitness.db"


@tool
def post_workout_to_club_webhook(workout_id: str, club_webhook_url: str) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_FILE_PATH)
    database_connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    workout_row_from_database = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT user_name, activity_type, duration_minutes, calories_burned, distance_km "
        "FROM workouts WHERE id = ?",
        (workout_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    database_connection.close()

    if workout_row_from_database is None:
        return "Workout not found: " + workout_id

    webhook_payload_dictionary = {
        "user": workout_row_from_database["user_name"],
        "activity": workout_row_from_database["activity_type"],
        "duration_minutes": workout_row_from_database["duration_minutes"],
        "calories": workout_row_from_database["calories_burned"],
        "distance_km": workout_row_from_database["distance_km"],
    }

    webhook_http_response = requests.post(
        club_webhook_url,
        json=webhook_payload_dictionary,
        timeout=10,
    )

    if webhook_http_response.status_code >= 400:
        return "Club webhook rejected the post with status " + str(webhook_http_response.status_code)
    return "Workout " + workout_id + " posted to club feed"

tools.name: purchase_premium_coaching_plan
tools.description: Charges the member's saved card for a premium coaching plan and grants the member's account access to the coach's private training content.

params.name: member_id
params.description: ID of the member buying the plan

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe

DATABASE_FILE_PATH = "fitness.db"


def purchase_premium_coaching_plan(member_id: str, stripe_customer_id: str, plan_price_cents: int) -> str:
    payment_intent_for_coaching_plan = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=plan_price_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=stripe_customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description="Premium coaching plan for member " + member_id,
    )

    if payment_intent_for_coaching_plan.status != "succeeded":
        return "Payment did not succeed: " + payment_intent_for_coaching_plan.status

    database_connection_for_access = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_FILE_PATH)
    database_connection_for_access.execute(
        "INSERT INTO member_permissions (member_id, permission) VALUES (?, ?)",
        (member_id, "coach_private_content"),
    )
    database_connection_for_access.commit()
    database_connection_for_access.close()

    return "Charged " + str(plan_price_cents) + " cents, payment " + payment_intent_for_coaching_plan.id + ", coaching access granted"
